author: Legoche
body:
=== This map is not complete yet ===

Hello! I have finally finished my Luar remix, to the point of YML. Please give feedback, changes can be made. This is my first map, please be nice :c

I need to do the YML still (my first one)

Here are some screenshots.

I will still remove some stuff and add some stuff if needed.

Here is what was added and removed:

-Water
-3rd Monument
-Removed one iron pile
-2 New islands
-Enchanter
-4 new diamond blocks per team (I may remove these)


Please give feedback ;)
